abilities.name: Zeal
abilities.description: Whitemane's healing Abilities apply Zeal for 8 seconds. Allies with Zeal are healed for 100% of the damage Whitemane deals to Heroes. Activate to gain 25% Spell Power and lose 15 Armor for 5 seconds. Can be cast while channeling abilities.; 40; trait

fields.type: Defensive damage modifier (active), Offensive damage modifier (active), Healing dealt modifier (active) / Healing (passive)
fields.notes: Healing from Zeal follows Lifesteal rules. Healing is calculated directly from final damage dealt and is unaffected by Spell Power's healing modifying properties. Spell Power stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting Whitemane's Spell Damage or healing output. Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Desperate Plea
abilities.description: Heal an allied Hero for 140 and gain Desperation for 4 seconds. Desperation increases Desperate Plea's Mana cost by 40, and stacks up to 3 times. Zeal Current Mana Cost: 40. Mana Cost at 3 stacks of Desperation 160.

abilities.name: Inquisition
abilities.description: Channel on an enemy Hero for up to 3 seconds, dealing 50 damage every 0.5 seconds and Slowing them by 30%. Removes a stack of Desperation. Shares a cooldown with Clemency.; 12 / 0.5

fields.notes: Inquisition can be canceled after 0.5 seconds by reactivating the Ability to end its effect early. The channel is interrupted if the target moves outside the active range. Cooldown begins at the start of channel.

abilities.name: Searing Lash
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, smite enemies in a straight line for 82 damage. If the first strike hits an enemy Hero, a second strike will occur after a short delay.

fields.notes: The second strike is perpendicular to the first.

abilities.name: Scarlet Aegis
abilities.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

fields.notes: Grants Zeal on cast to every hero inside Scarlet Aegis 's initial radius. Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Divine Reckoning
abilities.description: After 1 second, consecrate an area for 4 seconds, dealing 50 damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies inside. 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes is returned as Mana.

abilities.name: Clemency
abilities.description: Activate to cast Inquisition on an allied Hero, healing them for up to 329 over 3 seconds while Channeling. Shares a cooldown with Inquisition. Removes a stack of Desperation.

fields.notes: Clemency can be canceled after 0.5 seconds by reactivating it to end its effect early. Applies Zeal on every tick. The channel is interrupted if the target moves outside the active range. Cooldown begins at the start of channel.

talents.name: Pity the Frail
talents.description: For every Hero hit with Searing Lash, lower the cooldown of Inquisition by 1.5 second. Allies below 30% Health receive 25% more healing from Whitemane.

fields.notes: Pity the Frail can also affect the damage-based healing from Zeal, stacking additively with it. Bonus healing stacks additively with healing dealt modifiers that affect Whitemane's healing output and multiplicatively with healing received modifiers on the target.

_raw_fields: For every Hero hit with Searing Lash, lower the cooldown of Inquisition by 1.5 second. Allies below 30% Health receive 25% more healing from Whitemane.

talents.name: Righteous Flame
talents.description: Searing Lash deals 25% more damage to enemies. If the second strike hits an enemy Hero, they take an additional 25% damage and Whitemane gains 40% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Searing Lash 's damage.

_raw_fields: Searing Lash deals 25% more damage to enemies. If the second strike hits an enemy Hero, they take an additional 25% damage and Whitemane gains 40% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Inquisitor's Prayer
talents.description: Repeatable Quest Hit Heroes with Searing Lash. Repeatable Quest Hit 3 Heroes with Basic Attacks. Reward Permanently increase Whitemane's maximum Health by 3 and Mana by 2. Heroes hit with the second strike of Searing Lash count as 2 hits.
_raw_fields: Repeatable Quest Hit Heroes with Searing Lash. Repeatable Quest Hit 3 Heroes with Basic Attacks. Reward Permanently increase Whitemane's maximum Health by 3 and Mana by 2. Heroes hit with the second strike of Searing Lash count as 2 hits.

talents.name: Unwavering Faith
talents.description: Increase Whitemane's Basic Attack Range by 1.1. Whitemane gains 20% increased Basic Attack damage for each active Zeal buff.

talents.description: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

fields.notes: Bonus healing stacks additively with healing modifiers that affect Whitemane's healing dealt modifiers and multiplicatively with healing received modifiers on the target.

_raw_fields: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

talents.name: Indulgence
talents.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Increase this by an additional 5% for each active Zeal.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with itself, but not with other sources of Movement Speed.

_raw_fields: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Increase this by an additional 5% for each active Zeal.

fields.notes: Mark is removed without triggering the Spell Damage bonus, if the Basic Attack misses due to Whitemane being Blinded or the target Evading.

talents.description: Cooldown 30 Activate to cast a permanent Zeal on an allied Hero that costs no Mana and doesn't grant Desperation. Only one can be active at a time and has a global cast range.
